_comment: Переделка картинок пятнадцатой партии: у exceto не вышло исключение, у gestão pública флаг США, sou повторял eu.
exceto: a straight row of nine identical yellow rubber ducks on a plain white surface with one bright blue rubber duck among them in the middle, all ducks the same size and facing the same way
gestão pública: officials in formal clothes seated around a large horseshoe-shaped table in a wood-panelled city council chamber, microphones and documents in front of them, no flags anywhere in the room
sou: a woman doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope round her neck placing her open hand on her chest as she introduces herself to a patient, friendly smile
